I will not put chemical fertilizer on this small rented plot because I must save what I have for my maize fields where the harvest really feeds my family. I have kept seed from previous seasons for this crop, so I do not need to buy improved seed, and here in Dowa the rains come in November so I see no reason to irrigate. My children and I will work this intercropped piece with our own hands over about two weeks this season, but I cannot afford to hire ganyu labor for just this little plot.
